To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a new current-control scheme for the GSC of a DFIG-based wind power system to achieve three control targets under unbalanced grid-voltage conditions.
we propose a control and operation scheme of the DFIG-based wind power generation system to improve its stability and performance under unbalanced grid voltages.
a new current control scheme is presented for a DFIG based wind power generation systems under unbalanced grid conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the enhanced control and operation strategies of DFIG-based wind power systems.
the control of a DFIG-based wind power system under unbalanced conditions.
the reinforced control and operation of DFIG-based wind power generation systems under unbalanced grid-voltage conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented control scheme can be effectively used to improve the system performance and to enhance the operation of a DFIG-based wind power generation system.
the proposed control and operation scheme is able to effectively improve the system behaviors and enhance the power quality of the DFIG-based wind-power-generation system during voltage unbalance.
the presented control scheme can provide a reliable and robust operation for the DFIG-based wind power generation system during grid unbalance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed current control method can be used to achieve the control targets of the GSC and the RSC in DFIG-based wind power system under unbalanced conditions.
a DFIG-based wind-power-generation system can operate stably under unbalanced grid conditions by employing the presented control strategy.

the presented current controller is capable of suppressing the negative-sequence current components at grid frequency, which can effectively improve the power quality and reduce the mechanical stress on the wind turbine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed control scheme is capable of suppressing the pulsations in active power, reactive power, and unbalanced current outputs under unbalanced grid conditions.

the proposed current-control scheme can achieve a better performance than a conventional one, and that the RSC can be controlled to suppress the torque ripple at the grid frequency and its harmonics, while the GSC can be controlled in a way to reduce the unbalanced output current and the pulsations in total active or reactive output power.
the DFIG-based wind-power generation system can maintain its operation stability under unbalanced grid conditions by using the proposed control strategies.
